title: Test - Sol 6.1 vs Astra vs Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5, GBA pixel art in Butano
author: Downtown_Tone_
selftext:
I used the same prompt to Sol 6.1, Astra 6, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5. Asking it to make this basic rat enemy. I just asked for 4 different parts of the enemy template to be filled out rather than images for the whole template (no camera sweeps in this video. I asked for a quick rom test to see what it looks like in game on a small Analogue Pocket screen. All were using Max reasoning. 

My opinion - Astra (top right) looks the best, and fits in better with the rest of the game?

I asked each task to track usage, though it wasn't as in depth as i had hoped.

Estimate cost to generate each sprite:

Sol £0.07

Astra £0.34

Sonnet 0.60

Opus £1.00

Time to generate:

Sol 26 minutes

Astra 27.8 minutes

Sonnet 41.2 minutes

Opus 69 minutes

Claude models look freakish.
